categories.main_business_segments: Hainan Shennong Seed Industry Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the agricultural sector focusing on the breeding, production, and sales of high-quality hybrid seeds for major crops such as rapeseed, rice, and corn. The company also engages in agricultural product processing, agrochemical sales, and marine aquaculture seed breeding and sales, implementing a dual-driven strategy combining crop and aquatic seed industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced biological breeding technologies including molecular breeding, space breeding (with breeding materials sent on the Shenzhou 16 spacecraft), and integrated breeding programs for high-yield, high-oil-content, and disease-resistant crop varieties. Production methods include large-scale contracted seed production via organized farmer groups and leased land with hired labor, supported by standardized seed storage and quality control systems. In aquaculture, it uses land-based factory breeding combined with deep-sea cage farming, leveraging intelligent water quality control and disease prevention systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include farmers, agricultural cooperatives, distributors, and government procurement agencies primarily in major crop planting regions in Southwest, Central, East, and South China. The company also serves overseas markets in Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Africa. Its aquaculture products target marine farming enterprises and related industries, while processed agricultural products cater to food manufacturers and consumers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with core subsidiaries and breeding bases in Chongqing, Hunan, Guizhou, and Hainan provinces, covering major agricultural production areas. It also has international market presence in Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Africa. The aquaculture business leverages the Hainan Free Trade Port and coastal marine resources for deep-sea farming and seed breeding.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hainan Shennong Seed Industry Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the agricultural supply chain, focusing on seed breeding, production, and sales. It also extends downstream into agricultural product processing and aquaculture seedling production, forming an integrated breeding, propagation, and promotion ('育繁推一体化') model. The company controls core seed varieties and breeding technologies, positioning itself as a key seed supplier and innovator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-oil-content rapeseed, hybrid rice with low heavy metal absorption, and high-yield corn varieties, integrating biotechnology and digital technologies such as AI breeding, phenomics, and big data analytics. It is building an international-class South China breeding platform ('南繁硅谷') and advancing aquaculture seed breeding with a focus on disease resistance and environmental adaptability. Strategic R&D projects include intelligent yield prediction models, gene editing, and breeding for climate resilience, supported by extensive industry-academic collaborations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of seeds for rapeseed, rice, corn, and other crops, as well as sales of agricultural products like rapeseed oil and processed rice products. Additional revenue streams include agrochemical product sales, rental income from properties, and agricultural technical services. The company also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as a leading seed enterprise in China, particularly in rapeseed breeding where its 'Qingyou' series ranks first nationally in planted area. It is among the top three seed companies in rapeseed seed sales nationwide. It holds significant market share in Southwest China and is a key player in the national seed industry with strong government and industry recognition. Competitors include other domestic seed companies and multinational seed corporations, with the company emphasizing innovation and integrated breeding capabilities to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 156.5 million, a 6.13% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 50.6 million, worsening by 40.51%. Total assets grew 17.13% to RMB 1.17 billion, driven by investments in aquaculture infrastructure. The company maintains a stable but challenging growth trajectory, investing heavily in R&D (8.02% of revenue) and expanding its aquaculture business despite natural disaster impacts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through leading breeding technologies that produce high-yield, high-quality, and disease-resistant seed varieties, notably its 'Qingyou' rapeseed series with record-breaking oil content. It integrates crop and aquatic seed industries under a 'dual-driven' strategy, leveraging biotechnology and digital innovation to enhance seed quality and production efficiency. Its comprehensive 'good seed + good method' service model supports farmers with technical training and digital platforms, enhancing customer loyalty and promoting sustainable agricultural practices.
